email_subject: Application - US Social Media & Content Strategist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the US Social Media & Content Strategist role at Stanley/Stella. Your focus on brand storytelling, data-driven optimisation, and AI-assisted content production matches how I work every day.

In my current roles, I manage content calendars and publish across WordPress and Shopify, write SEO content that ranks, and use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track what works. I also use AI tools daily for research, content creation, and audits, and I've built sites with structured data and llms.txt to improve visibility in AI search. My technical background means I can coordinate smoothly with creative and product teams.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help strengthen Stanley/Stella's US presence and connect customers with your distributor network.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the US Social Media & Content Strategist position at Stanley/Stella. Your emphasis on brand storytelling, data-driven optimisation, and AI tools to scale content production is exactly the kind of work I do and want to do more of.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage content calendars and publish across WordPress and Shopify, write SEO blog and web content, and use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and refine what I publish. I use AI tools daily for research, content creation, and audits, and I've built sites with structured data and llms.txt to improve visibility in both traditional and AI-powered search. My front-end development background means I can work effectively with creative and product marketing teams and understand the technical side of content operations.

What draws me to this role is the chance to own the US content calendar, support paid campaigns, and develop creator partnerships while connecting customers with your distributor network. I haven't yet run paid social campaigns end-to-end, but I've worked with Google Ads and have a strong analytical approach that I'm confident will transfer. I'm fluent in English and comfortable working across teams and time zones.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my mix of SEO, content, AI, and web skills can help strengthen Stanley/Stella's US presence.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
